answer:
Among residents who dropped a programme, Central has the most who still attended at least one event occurrence, followed by West, North, North‑East and East (using where events were held, not home region).

| Event region | Residents who dropped a programme and attended ≥1 event |
|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| Central      | 95                                                     |
| West         | 57                                                     |
| North        | 52                                                     |
| North-East   | 51                                                     |
| East         | 51                                                     |

Relationships traversed: resident → droppedOut (programme) and resident → attended → event occurrence → heldIn (region).
